programmes.d: Get a sneak peek into how the Internet of Things will soon dominate daily life. As Edward Snowden provocatively points out, “TV is a medium that you watch. The Internet is a medium that watches you as you watch it.”

Explore how our reliance on the web creates vulnerability to everything from cyber theft to an Internet system failure. Muller introduces viewers to “white hat” hackers, the U.S. Secret Service’s cybercrime division and even West Point soldiers.

One of the most impressive steel bridges in the world can be found in Calcutta: the Howrah Bridge. Its predecessor is the Forth Bridge across the Firth of Forth, near the Scottish capital of Edinburgh.
The Great Seto Bridge in Japan and the Victoria Falls Bridge in Zimbabwe have more than one thing in common: they were built on dreams and are the only train connections between the two regions.

programmes.t: Health Explored S2 - "Sands of Time Part 1"
programmes.d: From environmental health to physical health, discover what coastal life is like in Morocco before heading inland to the desert.

programmes.t: Health Explored S2 - "Sands of Time Part 2"
programmes.d: Trek into the Sahara to camp and visit the nomads, to learn how climate change is impacting life in the desert and why time should be valued.
"Pura Vida" is a popular saying in Costa Rica, often translated as "pure life" or "simple life." We learn from centenarians from the Blue Zone why we should live a pure life.
We learn about conservation in Costa Rica from reforestation projects, to sustainable fishing and endangered turtle rescue.

programmes.t: Rethink S1 - "Is a telescope a time machine?"
programmes.d: In a world where nothing is what it seems, we explore tricks using sleight of hand. Play games with a water bottle, take a look at the Dunning Kruger effect and answer the question; Is a telescope a time machine?

In a world where nothing is what it seems, let’s play games with colour changing milk. Learn about chroma keys in video editing and do some mental math gymnastics. We’ll also explore the Leidenfrost effect and take a look at rethinker Linwood G Dunn.
Sharon Pincott, from Queensland, Australia, ditches her friends and material possessions to pursue a dangerous life in Robert Mugabe’s Zimbabwe – as caretaker of the ‘presidential herd’ of elephants.

programmes.t: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "The Big Relocate"
programmes.d: Three adult lions and two wild leopards must swap enclosures, a dangerous exercise and if things can go wrong, they will.

programmes.t: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "Big Cats & Baby Baboons"
programmes.d: Umbili and Shakira, the leopard cubs, are becoming a real threat to Zacheo’s safety and they must be moved, on a more comical note the baby baboons are moved in with the juveniles.
It’s a year later, and things have changed – Marlice and Rudie have a new baby boy – and he needs to be introduced to the animals.

programmes.t: Orphans of the Wild S1 - "New Beginning’s and Sad Endings"
programmes.d: Even at a Wildlife sanctuary poaching can rear it’s ugly head and quick action needs to be taken.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "The Old, the Bold and the Newborn"
programmes.d: A 17-year-old cat, a bulldog with a mystery swelling, newborn pups, and a mischievous puppy test the Blue Cross team’s skill and compassion.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Accidents, Surgeries and Fearful Friends"
programmes.d: The team springs into action for a a puppy hit by car, Westie's unusual surgery and a Staffordshire that fears fireworks.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Lumps, Jabs and Tiny Patients"
programmes.d: The team treats Labrador Scuby’s lumps, nervous cat Wotzit’s jabs, rescue collie Bob, and tiny rat Squeaky’s stomach growth in a day of unusual cases.

programmes.t: Animal Ambulance S1 - "Paws, Gums and Urgent Care"
programmes.d: Team faces a day of critical animal care with plus-size cat Bob to Angus’s gum surgery, a Husky’s sore paw, and Bandit’s urgent bladder operation.
Giant jellyfish are preparing to attack the coastal towns of Japan. Rising sea temperatures have seen an increase in these monsters, and this year will see the biggest attack ever.
